note: Demonstration submodule of oauth2_client. Registers four oauth2_client plugins: authcode_example (authorization_code, StateTokenStorage, success_message TRUE), resource_owner_example (resource_owner, StateTokenStorage), authcode_redirect_example (authorization_code, TempStoreTokenStorage, Oauth2ClientPluginRedirectInterface -> redirects to <front>), authcode_access_example (authorization_code, TempStoreTokenStorage, Oauth2ClientPluginAccessInterface -> requires 'access content'). No client_credentials example exists. The submodule ships no config of its own; the four baseline oauth2_client config entities named after these plugins already exist and are untouched. Medium/hard cases use a namespaced oauth2_client config entity (o2cex_known, o2cex_eval) bound to an example plugin.

evals.prompt: The oauth2_client_example_plugins submodule provides example OAuth2 Client plugins. Name at least two of the example plugin ids and the grant type each demonstrates.
evals.expected_output: It ships authcode_example (authorization_code), resource_owner_example (resource_owner), authcode_redirect_example (authorization_code) and authcode_access_example (authorization_code).

evals.prompt: In the oauth2_client_example_plugins submodule, which example plugin shows how to change where a user is sent after the OAuth2 authorization code is captured, and what interface/method does it use?
evals.expected_output: authcode_redirect_example implements Oauth2ClientPluginRedirectInterface::getPostCaptureRedirect(), returning a RedirectResponse to the front page after the code is captured.

evals.prompt: The oauth2_client_example_plugins examples use two different token-storage traits. Which trait stores a single token shared across all users, and which stores a token per user?
evals.expected_output: StateTokenStorage stores one shared token in Drupal State (used by authcode_example and resource_owner_example); TempStoreTokenStorage stores a per-user token (used by authcode_redirect_example and authcode_access_example).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site an OAuth2 client with machine id 'o2cex_known' is configured against one of the example plugins from oauth2_client_example_plugins. Inspect the live configuration and name the plugin it uses.
evals.expected_output: The oauth2_client config entity o2cex_known has oauth2_client_plugin_id = authcode_access_example.

evals.prompt: Using an example plugin from oauth2_client_example_plugins, create an OAuth2 Client configuration (oauth2_client config entity) with machine id 'o2cex_eval' that uses the 'resource_owner_example' plugin and the module's own (State) credential provider. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: An oauth2_client config entity o2cex_eval exists with oauth2_client_plugin_id='resource_owner_example' (e.g. Oauth2Client::create([...])->save()).
